title: Status- und Änderungshistorie
description: As a security admin, I want an audit trail of status changes, so that I can reconstruct what happened with a prompt.

acceptance_criteria.given: a version went from PENDING to SCANNING to APPROVED
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and lists all three transitions with timestamp and cause
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-025-audit-trail.feature: Every status transition is recorded

acceptance_criteria.given: a history belongs to a prompt of organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: a developer of organisation A requests it
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 404 and no history entry is returned
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-025-audit-trail.feature: The history of another organisation is not readable

acceptance_criteria.given: audit entries older than 90 days exist
acceptance_criteria.then: those entries are deleted and no prompt content is left behind
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-025-audit-trail.feature: Audit entries without content are removed after the retention period
